sources.scope: Partial bounded cadastral-reference coverage near Burewala in the Vehari layer; the exact unchanged WUP centre window has zero records. The northeast native-ID polygons establish local availability about 1.4 km from the locator. Layer extent is not a completeness mask. Native OBJECTID identifies the current public GIS row, not a legal cadastral key. No citywide completeness, currentness, survey accuracy or long-term OID continuity claim. Full returned polygons are preserved without clipping, simplification or fitted offsets. The spatial count endpoint disagrees with ID membership at exact parcel edges; bounded and exact reads instead compare independent complete ID-only rows with the native object-ID manifest before fetching full geometry.
